automations.name: No-Contact Follow-Up
automations.summary: When a new lead arrives and your team hasn't reached them yet, they get texts and emails over 4 days. It stops as soon as your team moves their card, they reply, or they opt out.
glance: A new lead arrives (web form, chat, Facebook, phone)
An alert when the lead replies
Your team moves the card, the lead replies or opts out, or after the last text

questions.text: Should leads you never reach be forwarded to your outside intake company?
questions.why: Right now nothing happens to these leads after the last text.

steps.title: New lead arrives in Lead Stages
Text 1
steps.sms: Hi [First name], thank you for contacting The Mahdavi Law Firm. Someone from our team will call you shortly from [Firm phone]. If now isn't a good time, reply with a better time. Reply STOP to opt out.

email.subject: We received your message – The Mahdavi Law Firm
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for reaching out to The Mahdavi Law Firm. We received your information, and someone from our team will call you shortly from [Firm phone].

If you'd rather pick the time, just reply to this email with a good time to call.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

steps.title: Text 2
steps.sms: Hi [First name], it's The Mahdavi Law Firm following up on your message. What's the best time for a quick call? Reply here or call [Firm phone]. Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.title: Text 3
steps.sms: Hi [First name], we'd still like to hear what happened and talk through your options. Call [Firm phone] or reply with a good time. – The Mahdavi Law Firm. Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.title: Email 2

email.subject: Still here to help, [First name]
email.body:
Hi [First name],

We tried to reach you about your message and haven't been able to connect yet. Talking with us is the quickest way to understand your options. There is no cost to speak with us.

Call us at [Firm phone], or reply with a good time and we'll call you.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

steps.note: Please confirm the line 'There is no cost to speak with us.'

steps.title: Text 4
steps.sms: [First name], insurance companies often move quickly after an accident. Before you speak with them, give us a call at [Firm phone]. – The Mahdavi Law Firm. Reply STOP to opt out.

email.subject: A few things to keep in mind after an accident
email.body:
Hi [First name],

While you decide on next steps, a few things can help protect your claim:

- Keep copies of medical records, bills, photos and any police report.
- Be careful about giving a recorded statement to an insurance company before you get advice.
- Write down what you remember while it's fresh.

If you'd like to talk it through, call [Firm phone] or reply to this email.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

steps.title: Text 5
steps.sms: Hi [First name], this is our last check-in from The Mahdavi Law Firm. If you'd still like help, reply YES or call [Firm phone] anytime. Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.title: Follow-up ends
steps.body: If we still haven't reached them, they move to the Long-Term Follow-Up the next day. Moving the card at any point stops it sooner.

automations.name: Agreement Sent Follow-Up
automations.summary: When your team moves a card to 'Agreement Sent – Awaiting Signature', the lead gets reminders to sign the Vine Sign agreement. If it's still unsigned after 4 days, you get an alert.
glance: Card moved to Agreement Sent – Awaiting Signature
A Day 4 alert and a call task
Agreement signed, lead marked lost, lead replies or opts out

questions.text: Who should get the Day 4 'still unsigned' alert besides Cyrus?
questions.why: As drafted, only Cyrus gets this alert.
options: Cyrus and someone else (tell us who)

questions.text: Is it OK that the texts don't include the signing link itself? (Vine Sign links are unique per client.)
questions.why: The texts point the lead to the link already sent by Vine Sign instead.

steps.title: Card moved to Agreement Sent – Awaiting Signature
Text 1
steps.sms: Hi [First name], it's The Mahdavi Law Firm. We sent your agreement by text through Vine Sign, and it only takes a few minutes to sign on your phone. Questions? Reply here or call [Firm phone]. Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.title: Text 2
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just checking that you received your agreement link. Once it's signed, our team can start working on your case right away. – The Mahdavi Law Firm. Reply STOP to opt out.

email.subject: Your agreement with The Mahdavi Law Firm
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for speaking with us. We sent your agreement by text through Vine Sign so you can review and sign it on your phone.

Once it's signed, our team can start working on your case. If you have questions, or can't find the link, reply to this email or call [Firm phone] and we'll help.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

steps.title: Text 3
steps.sms: Have any questions about the agreement before you sign? We're happy to go over it with you. Call [Firm phone] or reply with a good time. – The Mahdavi Law Firm. Reply STOP to opt out.

steps.title: Text 4
steps.sms: Hi [First name], can't find the signing link? Reply RESEND and we'll send it again. – The Mahdavi Law Firm. Reply STOP to opt out.

email.subject: Following up on your agreement
email.body:
Hi [First name],

We haven't received your signed agreement yet. If you're still deciding, or have questions about anything in it, we're glad to walk you through it.

Call [Firm phone] or reply to this email, and we'll resend the signing link if you need it.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

steps.title: Alert: agreement still unsigned
steps.body:
Subject: Agreement still unsigned: [Full name]

[Full name] has not signed after 4 days of reminders.
Phone: [Phone] · Email: [Email] · Source: [Lead source]

Next step: call them, forward the lead to the outside intake company, or mark the card Lost to stop all messages.

steps.title: Task: call the lead
steps.body: A task is created for the assigned team member: Call [Full name] – agreement unsigned after 4 days.

automations.name: Long-Term Follow-Up
automations.summary: Leads we couldn't reach after 4 days, and leads moved to Lead Thinking, get 6 emails over about 3.5 months.
glance: Not reached after the No-Contact Follow-Up, or card moved to Lead Thinking
After the 6th email, or on a reply, an unsubscribe, any other card move, or Won/Lost

questions.text: How long should the long-term follow-up run?
Do you send a newsletter we should add these leads to?

steps.title: Lead not reached after 4 days, or card moved to Lead Thinking
steps.note: Emails only, about 3.5 months, for leads we couldn't reach after 4 days and leads moved to Lead Thinking. Stops on a reply, an unsubscribe, any other card move, or Won/Lost.

email.subject: Still here when you're ready, [First name]
email.body:
Hi [First name],

We know there's a lot to deal with after an accident, and calling a law firm may not be at the top of your list. Whenever you're ready, we're happy to answer your questions and explain your options.

Call [Firm phone] or reply to this email with a good time to talk.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

email.subject: Why it helps to get answers early
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Injury claims have legal time limits, and evidence like photos, witness details and medical records is easier to gather early. A short conversation now can help you understand where you stand, even if you decide not to move forward.

Call [Firm phone] or reply to this email.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

email.subject: If the insurance company calls
email.body:
Hi [First name],

If an insurance adjuster contacts you, you don't have to answer every question or accept the first offer on the spot. It's worth getting advice first.

If you'd like to talk it through, call [Firm phone] or reply here.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

email.subject: Checking in from The Mahdavi Law Firm
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Just checking in. If anything has changed since you contacted us (new medical bills, a call from an insurer, or questions about your claim), we're here to help.

Call [Firm phone] or reply to this email.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

email.subject: Still here if you need us
email.body:
Hi [First name],

A quick note to say we're still here if you have questions after your accident. A conversation with our team is a simple way to understand your options.

Call [Firm phone] or reply anytime.

The Mahdavi Law Firm team

email.subject: Our last check-in
email.body:
Hi [First name],

This is our last scheduled check-in. If you ever need help after an accident, you can reach us at [Firm phone] or by replying to this email.

Wishing you a good recovery,
The Mahdavi Law Firm team

automations.name: Signed Case Handoff
automations.summary: When a card is moved to Agreement Signed (or marked Won), Cyrus and your case manager get an email with the new client's details, and all automated follow-up stops.
glance: Card moved to Agreement Signed or marked Won
One email with the client's details

questions.why: This email tells your case manager to open the new case in FileVine.
options: Tell us their name and email in a change request

steps.title: Email to Cyrus and your case manager
steps.body:
Subject: New signed case: [Full name]

[Full name] has signed their agreement. Please open the case in FileVine.
Phone: [Phone] · Email: [Email] · Source: [Lead source]

All automated follow-up for this lead has stopped.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Later, this can open the case in FileVine automatically.

automations.name: Reply Alert for Your Team
automations.summary: Whenever a contact replies by text, email or call, everyone on your team gets a text with who it is and what they said.

steps.title: A contact replies
steps.body: Starts every time any contact replies to a text or email, or calls in.
steps.note: This alert stays in Draft until launch. It'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: Your team gets a text
steps.body:
Everyone on your team gets this text:

“New Incoming Reply / Email / Call from: [Contact name] [Contact email] [Contact phone]

Message: “[Message]””
steps.note: This goes to every user in your account, for every reply from any contact, including existing clients. Busy accounts can get a lot of texts. We can limit it to new leads only, or to one intake person.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Nothing is sent to the contact.

questions.text: Who should get these reply alerts?
questions.why: Right now every user in your account gets a text for every reply.
options: Only the intake team (tell us who)

questions.text: Which replies should trigger an alert?
questions.why: Alerting on every contact, including existing clients, can be noisy.

automations.name: Chat Lead to Lead Board
automations.summary: When a chat starts, this waits for the visitor's phone and email, then adds them to your lead board so your team can follow up.
glance: A new card on your lead board
When the card is created, or after 30 minutes

steps.title: A website chat starts
steps.body: Starts when the chat intake begins (the contact is tagged “pi-chat-started”).
steps.note: Unlike the other automations here (all Draft), this one is already published and running in GHL.

steps.title: If we have their phone and email, they go on your lead board
steps.body: If the contact has both a phone number and an email, a card is created in Lead Stages › Stage 1: Web Lead.

steps.title: Second check
steps.body: If the phone or email was still missing, it checks again after 25 more minutes and creates the card if both are there now.
steps.note: If either is still missing after 30 minutes, no card is created and nobody is told. We can add a task or alert for your team in that case.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Nothing is sent to the lead.

questions.text: What should happen if a chat visitor never gives a phone and email?
questions.why: Right now they are not added to your lead board and nobody is told.
options: Alert our team so we can follow up (recommended)
